name: java-batch-job
description: A minimal standalone Java batch job scaffold with Maven layout, console entrypoint, Docker support, and Jenkins pipeline support.
recommended_use: Use for offline batch jobs, data-processing scripts, scheduled console utilities, and portfolio-ready Java command-line scaffolds that run without a web server. Maven builds resolve dependencies through Nexus.
smoke_test_command: test -f pom.xml && test -f src/main/java/com/example/java_batch_job_validate_smoke/BatchJob.java && grep -q 'public static void main' src/main/java/com/example/java_batch_job_validate_smoke/BatchJob.java
